name: vvmp
description: Reference implementation and package workspace for the Verifiable Video Manifest Protocol.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @vvmp/trust-core && npm run build --workspace @vvmp/trust-schema && npm run build --workspace @vvmp/policy-pack-sdk && npm run build --workspace @vvmp/trust-capture-sdk && npm run build --workspace @vvmp/trust-registry && npm run build --workspace @vvmp/trust-registry-client && npm run build --workspace @vvmp/trust-c2pa-adapter && npm run build --workspace @vvmp/trust-cli && npm run build --workspace @vvmp/trust-viewer && npm run build --workspace @vvmp/trust-registry-app
scripts.build:schema: npm run build --workspace @vvmp/trust-core && npm run build --workspace @vvmp/trust-schema
scripts.build:capture: npm run build --workspace @vvmp/policy-pack-sdk && npm run build --workspace @vvmp/trust-capture-sdk
scripts.build:registry-core: npm run build --workspace @vvmp/policy-pack-sdk && npm run build --workspace @vvmp/trust-registry
scripts.build:registry-client: npm run build --workspace @vvmp/trust-registry && npm run build --workspace @vvmp/trust-registry-client
scripts.build:registry: npm run build:registry-core && npm run build --workspace @vvmp/trust-registry-app
scripts.build:cli: npm run build:registry-client && npm run build --workspace @vvmp/trust-c2pa-adapter && npm run build --workspace @vvmp/trust-cli
scripts.serve:viewer:e2e: npm run build --workspace @vvmp/trust-viewer && npm run start --workspace @vvmp/trust-viewer -- --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3201
scripts.conformance: npm run conformance:js && npm run conformance:py && npm run conformance:swift
scripts.verify:e2e: npm run conformance && npm run build && npm run smoke:core && npm run smoke:schema && npm run smoke:policy && npm run smoke:registry && npm run smoke:registry-client && npm run smoke:registry-cli && npm run smoke:capture && npm run smoke:example && npm run smoke:recovery && npm run smoke:c2pa && npm run smoke:c2pa-matrix && npm run smoke:c2pa-trust-program && npm run smoke:trustmark && npm run test:viewer:e2e
